findings.title: Raw startup context obtains ten-second authority and eleven-second lease before strict validation/binding
findings.requirement: startup:object must strictly deny malformed/type/forged context before startup-only authority or lease effects; a qualified DATA envelope is not current owner authority.
findings.mechanism: runtime_authority calls qualify(), which checks the outer field set, digest envelope, requested/purpose and seven refs, but not the context field set/authority scalar types/current instance-owner binding or full material. The new UPDATE therefore commits through its normal path for invalid startup data. RuntimeClient.managed uses the same partial qualifier, so the actual client-to-Host path reaches the lease write before the Host refuses.

steps: Build the existing complete v5 fixture using prepared_source() and produce(); retain real seven-record/material structure.
Use the real InstanceService with only its locked-storage seam replaced by a deterministic clock/lease fixture. Valid matching control receives grant10 and lease11.
Recompute the ordinary content digest after changing authority.epoch to true, deleting authority, adding an unknown context key, clearing material, or substituting a foreign authority.owner.
Each mutation still receives grant10 and executes the lease11 UPDATE. The first four fail Host data validation; foreign owner passes Host data validation.
Send boolean-epoch case through the real RuntimeClient.managed and real RuntimeHost UDS. RuntimeUnavailable is returned only after one new lease UPDATE; no native process is created.

findings.impact: Malformed/nonmatching bootstrap data can prolong the current owner lease and obtain the special grant at its producer. Host rejection limits impact: no unauthorized model/native execution was observed or claimed. The source producer violates the explicitly required pre-effect strictness.
findings.minimal_remedy: Before the UPDATE, validate the context exact fields/types, material/record contract and bind its instance_id/owner/epoch/generation to the locked instance/current owner. Strengthen or reuse the existing API-side validator without importing the optional native adapter or introducing a generic authority bypass. Keep valid v5/v6 positives and require malformed/foreign negatives to leave the lease unchanged; Host refusal must remain defense in depth.
findings.required_recheck: Parent reproduce on frozen source, add failing pre-UPDATE malformed/foreign tests, minimal fix, affected SOURCE regression and focused independent re-review. Real PG proves actual rollback/nonmutation later.
